text:
Title is in the friend. The shopkeeper's gift over to "the children of my sister who reach the age of 25" is an executory interest. It violates the Rule Against Perpetuities, because the property might not be used for church purposes until long after any life in being plus 21 years, so it cannot be certain to vest or fail within the period. Once the executory interest is struck, the friend's fee simple is no longer subject to defeasance and becomes a fee simple absolute.

CONFIDENCE: 88
